title: Edge Case
proposition: An edge case is a valid or invalid scenario near a behavioral boundary where ordinary assumptions are most likely to fail.
scope: Technology-neutral curriculum statement for V01-C03 within Volume 01 Programming Foundations.
exceptions: Concrete implementations, organizational practices, or domain constraints may require a narrower application of this proposition.
score_rationale: Tier 1 curriculum evidence supports the bounded foundational proposition; formal Claim Review and any needed domain-specific corroboration remain required before production approval.
